name: Corpcore
summary: Corpcore is characterized by its mixture of old business wear trends with current casual wear fashion.
description: Corpcore is characterized by its mixture of old business wear trends with current casual wear fashion. It is heavily inspired by 90s workwear and tailoring, borrowing oversized and boxy fits from that era, as well as professional wear in general, and combining it with more casual, modern pieces like jeans and sneakers. In this way, it both elevates the basics and adds a unique pop of personality to professional clothing. Common visuals are exaggerated shoulders, cropped blazers, wide-legged trousers, layers, pleats, bows, pinstripes, and glasses, paired with sneakers, t-shirts, straight-legged jeans, baseball caps and jewelry.
culturalContext: The term "CorpCore" was first coined by the fashion brand HUGO BOSS as the name of the collection showcased in their 2023 Fall/Winter show, BOSS: Techtopia, held on September 22nd, 2023 in Milan. In this show, BOSS highlighted deconstructed office wear designs -- belts emphasizing boxy cuts, deep slits bringing a sensual edge to the professional looks -- and "playful but functional" accessories. Even further casual stylings were juxtaposed with the workwear on display as models touted deep V-necks, chest-revealing tops, hoodies, and crocodile-embossed leather pieces. BOSS then released their Spring/Summer 2024 collection with a campaign titled "#BeYourOwnBOSS", a continuation of their Techtopia theme. fashion.Overview: Corpcore fashion is characterized by the synthesis of casual wear and workwear, often with exaggerated silhouettes as a reference to the Power Dressing of the 1980s. This aesthetic aims to modernize professional attire in two ways: by making it more relaxed and accessible to the modern worker through the addition of casual wear, and by enhancing it to high fashion standards through thoughtful tailoring and using quality materials. Thus, Corpcore outfits incorporate both ends of the style, mixing everyday clothing with eye-catching fabrics and silhouettes.
